where: Lowtinder and Tinderwick Bay (the drowned old Tinderwick under the bay, swum to with Tidecall; half-sunk roofs, a cold bell-tower, one warm window: Gran Tallow's lamp-house) + the lamp-school's moss-garden
mood: The hometown lullaby, drowned: the same tune heard from under forty years of quiet sea. Cosy-melancholy, tender, a little haunted but never frightening; a music-box in an upstairs window.
